blogTitle: The Best Online Tools for Interior Design Planning
videoTitle: The Best Online Tools for Interior Design Planning
script:
The Best Online Tools for Interior Design Planning

You know that feeling when you're staring at a blank wall… and you just have NO idea where to start? Yeah — these tools are going to change that.

[warmly] So before we even get to the big-name platforms — I want to show you what we've built right here on About Wall Art… six FREE tools, no sign-up, nothing.

There's a Room Colour Art Matcher, a Wall Art Size Calculator, an Art Hanging Height Calculator… honestly, the size calculator alone is a GAME changer — most people hang art that's way too small.

And there's a Gallery Wall Planner — plan your whole layout DIGITALLY before a single nail goes in the wall… trust me, this one saves so much stress.

They've also got an Interior Style Quiz — sixty seconds and it tells you your design style, with personalised recommendations. A little tip I love: do this FIRST before you buy anything.

Plus six FREE design guides — covering everything from colour matching to 24 interior styles — downloadable as PDFs, again no account needed.

[curious] Okay — so what ARE the best online tools for interior design planning right now? Let's get into it…

Tools like Planner 5D and Roomstyler 3D let you map out your WHOLE floor plan in 3D — you can test furniture layouts before moving a single thing in real life.

Here's the thing about COLOUR — getting it wrong is one of the most common mistakes I see… and that's exactly where digital tools earn their keep.

Canva's Colour Palette Generator is brilliant for this — and our own Room Colour Art Matcher does the same thing specifically for wall art. You tell it your wall colour… it tells you exactly what art works.

[warmly] And Homestyler and the IKEA Room Planner are great for furniture placement — you can actually see if that sofa FITS before it's delivered… which, trust me, matters.

Now — digital tools are amazing, but they work BEST when you combine them with the fundamentals… balance, proportion, rhythm. Our free design guides cover all of that.

Planner 5D and Roomstyler are honestly the go-to platforms — they're intuitive, they look good, and they're free to start… no reason NOT to try them.

Space planning digitally means you can try ten layouts in an afternoon — instead of pulling your back out rearranging actual furniture… you know?

[excited] And yes — online tools absolutely help with colour palettes too. The key is picking ONE dominant wall colour and working outward from there… our Colour Matching Guide covers ten proven strategies for exactly this.

Think about it room by room — the living room needs different art sizing to a bedroom or hallway… and that's where the Wall Art Size Calculator really earns its place.

Free vs paid… honestly? For most people the free tools — including everything on About Wall Art — are MORE than enough. You don't need to spend a penny to plan a beautiful home.

If you're pulling a living room together right now — this set of three contemporary prints is one I'd genuinely point a client toward… the colours are calm, the sizing is perfect for a feature wall.

Or if you want something with a little more structure — a framed set of three like this gives you that gallery-wall feel without the planning stress… already balanced for you.

[softly] This contemporary set… it's one of my favourites for a living room that needs a focal point but doesn't want to shout. Calm, considered, really easy to live with.

Three prints, contemporary artwork, coordinates beautifully — this is the kind of set the Wall Art Size Calculator will tell you is IDEAL for a standard living room wall above a sofa.

And if you're decorating with an Islamic aesthetic in mind — this gold art print set is stunning… the Room Colour Art Matcher pairs it beautifully with deep neutrals or warm white walls.

Did you know styling your home doesn't have to be guesswork?

We've built a free set of Home Decor tools and styling guides…

From colour theory and design principles to gallery wall layouts and art sizing. Download them all from our site!

Find all you need to transform your home into a calming oasis!

Happy Decorating!
